scripts.desktop:build: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- build
scripts.android:init: npm run tauri -- android init && npm run icons:generate
scripts.android:dev: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- android dev
scripts.android:run: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- android run
scripts.android:build: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- android build
scripts.ios:init: npm run tauri -- ios init && npm run icons:generate
scripts.ios:dev: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios dev
scripts.ios:run: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios run
scripts.ios:build: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios build
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios dev --target aarch64-sim
scripts.ios:build:simulator: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios build --target aarch64-sim --debug
scripts.ios:build:app-store: npm run icons:generate && npm run tauri -- ios build -- --export-method app-store-connect
